name: P-8A Poseidon
note: Boeing P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol / anti-submarine aircraft, based on the 737-800. Crew of 2 flight + 7 mission. AN/APY-10 maritime surveillance radar, MAD, and acoustic sonobuoys. Primary weapons: Mk 54 lightweight torpedo (ASW) and AGM-84 Harpoon (anti-ship); also mines.

source.title: APY-10 radar range not published
source.note: AN/APY-10 maritime surveillance radar; no published detection range. ~370 km is an estimate for a large surface-search radar against a ship. Subsurface targets are found by MAD and acoustic sonobuoys, not radar.

source.title: Mk 54 range not published
source.note: Mk 54 lightweight torpedo; effective run commonly cited ~9 km. Not stated on the retrieved page. Estimate.

source.title: Boeing P-8 Poseidon | Wikipedia
